stemMarkdown: A boat whose speed in still water is 12 km/h rows 36 km downstream and returns to the starting point. If the stream flows at 3 km/h, find the total time taken (in hours). (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Downstream: $\dfrac{36}{15} = 2.4000$ hours. Upstream: $\dfrac{36}{9} = 4.0000$ hours. Total $= 6.4$ hours.
altSolutionMarkdown: The return trip always takes longer than the outward one, so the round trip is never just twice the still-water time.
